starters: Year 2045. In the basement of an old university library, young engineers uncovered a mysterious terminal displaying a glowing green chameleon...
During a midnight hackathon at 3:15 AM, the lights suddenly cut out and the only active laptop screen flashed an encrypted warning...
Our team expedition reached the edge of an uncharted valley where compass needles began spinning wildly in reverse...
Day one of the space research internship began with an emergency alert: the automated system locked down all exits...
